purpose: Compatibility audit before committing English trial support, launch controls, T10 structure fixes, cancellation probes, and a separate MMA numerical profile.
interpretation: Public checks are smoke/parameter compatibility checks, not complete functional acceptance.
Candidate defects and deliberately invalid starter/fixture RTL may fail; existing public failures were compared against the baseline commit.

T05 CDC checker is unchanged; T10 hierarchy checks use the current staged implementation. Two preexisting T10 non-passes were separately checked against baseline: packed 83-bit operand ports are not recognized, and a legacy asynchronous write pattern is rejected by Slang after the native frontend times out. These are not new regressions or new score deductions.
MMA results are a separate non-scoring audit; diagnostic lanes are excluded from numerical passes. The stricter oracle remains byte-identical.
Two Claude MMA reports were reused only after checking identical RTL and verifier hashes; all 16 T10 structure reports were freshly generated.
Nine archived retired-task paths (including duplicates) have no current task contract and received compilation checks only.
Historical T10 report dependencies retain their recorded hashes through archived source bytes. No historical PPA was rerun.
